review.summary: Accept release-readiness attempt 2. The earlier findings are addressed, and the source-bound checks and retained archives support 0.2.5 readiness. This does not establish completion of phase 31; remote delivery and documentation-site acceptance remain pending.
evidence: Read AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, docs/PHASES.md, the accepted Portkey plan, phase-31 status and attempt-1 findings.

Independently recomputed fingerprint adbdec87ffba019d14c68d44c509e5cf6ab5cea1a3b638bc62565cb59a31612d. All 113 commands in docs/checks/phase-31.json exactly match commands_for(31), with zero exits and no timeouts.
Verified both retained compiler archives: hashes, sizes, all 145 file inventories, current source/example bytes and release-commit fingerprints match. Both archives contain identical file contents.
Inspected recorded extracted-package checks and external consumer execution on Rust 1.89.0 and 1.99.0, including directional-profile consumers.

Inspected release scripts, review gates and regression tests. Registry verification accepts the phase-31 Codex readiness path; complete-phase review and completion require delivery verification. Unix permission handling is conditionally compiled with a non-Unix refusal fallback.

Executed both credential-free live-receipt validators successfully. MCP evidence records 19 successful steps, two fixtures deleted and no uncertain fixtures. General live evidence verifies OAuth only; target-list probes retain their HTTP 403 limitations.
Inspected workflow and release-documentation changes; the configured delivery matrix contains 49 CI contexts.
limitations: Compiler, package and full regression suites were not rerun; their recorded results were inspected and archive integrity independently checked.
Windows compilation remains unverified. Source inspection confirms platform gating, but the static regression does not replace native compilation.
Registry publication, remote annotated tags, terminal CI and Docusaurus build/deployment were not verified; they belong to pending chunks.
No files were modified, credentials or tenant registrations read, tenants contacted, or network requests made.
